tasks.title: Secure FFmpeg render worker lifecycle
acceptance: Owned source asset registration and hash-verified staging
Durable render job state with lease fencing and crash recovery
Allowlisted FFmpeg binary and argv-only execution; no shell or arbitrary URLs
Bounded input size, clip count, CPU, memory and runtime
Audio mixing and ffprobe output validation
external_gates: Production filesystem isolation and resource limits

tasks.title: Real provider contract and end-to-end media validation
acceptance: Verify each configured provider against its actual HTTPS contract
Generate and inspect real script, voice track and MP4
Record provider cost, latency, failure and artifact provenance
Keep output in review_pending until human approval
external_gates: Operator-supplied credentials and approved spend ceiling
Provider contract, licensing and data-processing review

tasks.title: Production deployment and recovery readiness
acceptance: Persistent storage, backup retention and off-host copy verified
Restore drill and service restart verified on target host
One approved private test upload and reconciliation completed
external_gates: Target host access and deployment authorization
YouTube OAuth and explicit private-test authorization
